heading: **25 February 2026**
body:
*Libraries for long-read sequencing*

1. lig50k (sheared to 20k) \- No Hia5 treatment  
2. 293T (sheared to 20k) \+ nucleosomes \+ Hia5  
3. Plasmid Fiber-Seq HAP1 HRS- 12  
4. Plasmid Fiber-Seq HAP1 HRS- 18  
5. Plasmid Fiber-Seq HepG2 HRS- 12  
6. Plasmid Fiber-Seq HepG2 HRS- 18  
7. 147HTFS  
8. N40HTFS  
9. 147NCFS  
10. N40NCFS

*qPCR Mix*

qPCR (6 plates)

| qPCR Plates |  |  |  |
| ----- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Reagents | per well in 384 | per 384-well plate | for 6 plates (x440) |
| NF water | 2.91 μL | 1.12 mL | 7.68 mL |
| 5x Phusion HF buffer | 1.25 μL | 480 μL | 3.3 mL |
| 10mM e dNTP | 0.25 μL | 96 μL | 660 μL |
| NCAP\_F 100μM  | 0.025 μL | 9.6 μL | 66 μL |
| NCAP\_R 100μM  | 0.025 μL | 9.6 μL | 66 μL |
| MgCl2 (50mM) | 0.0325 μL | 12.48 μL | 85.8 μL |
| Hot Start Phusion DNA Pol | 0.0375 μL | 14.4 μL | 99 μL |
| 100x SYBR (final 1:200) | 0.06 μL | 23.04 μL | 158.4 μL |
| Total | 4.59 μL | 1.765 mL | 12.1155 mL |

To prepare 100x SYBR Green: add 5μL 10,000x SYBR Green into 500μL DMSO, which can be found in Phusion DNA Pol kits. Avoid light.  
Manually load 122μL mix into each well of a 96-well plate (AB0765), then transfer 4.5μL/well into 6x 384-well plates (LightCycler 384).

*PCR1 Mix*

Prepare 3 sets each using the mix below:

*PCR2 Mix*

Dilution 2-cycle PCR2 (For 8 plates)

Prepare 3 sets each using the mix below:

| PCR Plates |  |  |  |
| ----- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Reagents | per well in 384 | per 384-well plate | for 8 plates (x8.5) |
| NF water | 11.59μL | 4.451mL | 37.84mL |
| 5x Phusion HF buffer | 5.02μL | 1.928mL | 16.39mL |
| 10mM e dNTP | 1.01μL | 387.84μL | 3.296mL |
| NCAP\_F 100μM  | 0.1μL | 38.4μL | 326.4μL |
| NCAP\_R 100μM  | 0.1μL | 38.4μL | 326.4μL |
| MgCl2 (50mM) | 0.131μL | 50.30μL | 427.6μL |
| Hot Start Phusion DNA Pol | 0.1457μL | 55.95μL | 475.6μL |
| Total | 18.1μL | 6.947mL | 59.05mL |

Manually load 606μL mix into each well of a 96-well plate (AB0765), then transfer 18μL/well into 384-well plates (4ti-0384C).  
Seal the plates, freeze at \-20℃ until use.
